gate.title: Catalog availability
gate.body: When enabled, workspace owners can connect their Meta Commerce catalog at <link>/catalog</link> and send Single Product, Multi-Product, and Catalog-CTA messages from the chat and flow builder. Switch off to hide the menu entry across all workspaces (existing connections stay intact but become read-only).
gate.commerceHint: Lets merchants accept in-WhatsApp payment via a connected Commerce Account. Requires Meta-approved Commerce Account + supported region.

api.title: Graph API version
api.intro: Every catalog operation (send, sync, push) goes through this Graph API version. Meta ships a new version every ~3 months and supports the previous one for ~2 years.
api.versionHint: Format: v'{'major'}'.'{'minor'}', for example v23.0. Leave it blank to use the default.
api.currencyHint: ISO-4217 code (3 letters). Used as the default for new catalogs; each Meta Commerce catalog still locks to a single currency.

app.title: Platform-wide Meta app
app.intro: Only needed if you plan to ship an "Install with Meta" OAuth experience. The default flow has each merchant paste their own system-user token on the catalog page, so no app credentials are required.
app.idHint: From developers.facebook.com → your app → Settings → Basic.
app.secretHint: Encrypted at rest. Used to verify Webhook payload signatures (X-Hub-Signature-256).

walk.title: How a workspace connects its catalog
walk.intro: Shown to merchants on the catalog page. Reproduced here so you can sanity-check the flow.

waba.title: Have an active WABA + Phone Number ID
waba.body: The merchant needs a verified WhatsApp Business Account in Meta Business Suite with at least one approved phone number. Without this, no catalog message can send.

catalog.title: Create a catalog in Meta Commerce Manager
catalog.body: At business.facebook.com/commerce → Create catalog → pick e-commerce. Add products manually, via CSV, or pull from Shopify/Woo. Catalog must be Public and locked to one currency.

link.title: Connect the catalog to the WABA
link.body: In Business Suite → WhatsApp Manager → Catalog tab → "Choose a catalog" → pick the one created in Step 2. This is what enables Cloud API product messages.

token.title: Generate a System User token
token.body: Business Settings → System Users → Add → Admin. Generate a token with whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management, catalog_management, business_management. Pick "Never" for expiry to avoid quarterly re-auth.

paste.title: Paste credentials on the catalog page
paste.body: WABA ID, Catalog ID, Phone Number ID, and the System User token go on the workspace-side catalog page. It then runs a test GET /{CATALOG_ID}?fields=name,product_count to verify the token has catalog_management on that catalog.

side.hereBody: Feature toggle, Graph API version, default currency, optional Meta App credentials.
side.merchantBody: WABA ID, Catalog ID, Phone Number ID, System User token. Meta requires the catalog be owned by the merchant's Commerce Account, so there is no shared catalog.
